reviewNotes: Directory research 2026-10-04: Logo is the site icon (512 px illustration); the site header shows the name as text only. Photos are the studio's own pictures from the homepage cards; other homepage images (wedding hands, outdoor crowd, bride bouquet, kids class) look like stock photos and were skipped. County: Farmingdale village is in Nassau (listing sites also say Nassau County) even though the phone uses a 631 area code. A Facebook page under the old name (facebook.com/danceobsessionballroom) exists at the same address but is not linked from the current site and may be inactive, so it was not recorded. Text line (877) 611-5114 not recorded as the main phone.
